thread:
anya: Bringing up tilt7b (open) with int4 and head-mux export enabled. Immediate QA regression: fact recall drops, and logs show alternating kv cache warnings. Anyone familiar with head-mux interleaving + rotary scaling?

kevin: Head-mux = head-interleaved layout. Our runtime historically assumes contiguous. Did exporter set head_layout="interleaved"? Also check rotary.base_mult and sin/cos dtype.

pat: I saw similar on another model where exporter permuted proj order and projector quant params misaligned per-head. Share the exact converter/quant commands.

anya: Export command I used:
```
python tools/convert_ckpt.py --in tilt7b/ --out models/tilt7b/redwood --head-mux interleaved --tokenizer bpe --norm NFC
python tools/quantize.py models/tilt7b/redwood --mode int4 --scheme asymmetric_per_channel
```

kevin: Two quick repros to isolate: (A) float export with head-mux interleaved + runtime remap enabled; (B) quant export with head-mux interleaved but preserve rotary fp16. Also dump sin_table head slices for first 6 freqs.

anya: Ran (A): float + runtime remap => QA close to baseline. Ran (B): quant => QA down. Dumped sin_table diff: head2 sin values scaled ~0.994 vs float. meta.json lacks rotary.base_mult (was in float ckpt).

ml-bot: Linter: tokenizer normalization mismatch (training=NFKC, conversion=NFC) detected. Report: /lint/reports/8645000000

pat: Tokenizer normalization can change ZWJ/soft-hyphen handling; those shifts often trigger kv_cache token_id_shift warnings on warmup. Also check token freq changes for named entities / contractions.

kevin: Try quantizing with symmetric_per_channel, disable blockwise grouping, and keep rotary/positional in fp16. Example:
```
python tools/quantize.py models/tilt7b/redwood --mode int4 --scheme symmetric_per_channel --no-blockwise --preserve rotary,position
```

anya: Tried that combo: symmetric_per_channel + rotary FP16 -> QA improved (F1 0.71 -> 0.78) but float baseline is 0.82. Also toggled runtime flag --disable-fused-heads for int path: kv warnings vanished but latency +10%.

deploy-bot: Canary queued: tilt7b-int4-canary in us-west (3 reps). Dashboard: https://ci.internal/redwood/canary/8645000000

pat: Follow-ups: (1) add converter assertion to copy rotary.base_mult into meta.json, (2) add linter rule for head_layout != "contiguous" and recommend runtime remap, (3) document preference: symmetric_per_channel + rotary FP16 retention for interleaved-head exports. Filing ticket ML-ONB-8780 with repro artifacts.

anya: Uploading repro script, tokenizer diffs, and sin_table dumps to ML-ONB-8780. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
